You will have a captain who has taken hundreds of these cruises and knows the best location for that perfect photo opportunity and the best locations to experience breathtaking sunsets. blurb: Guests join boat tours to see dolphins, manatees, birds, fish, and learn about the South Florida Keys wildlife. Tours include snorkeling adventures, coral restoration education, sandbar visits, and sunset cruises. The company is dog friendly and offers pet sitting accommodations.
extraNote: Gift card sales are final and non-refundable. · If you need to cancel or reschedule your tour please notify us 48 hours before the time of your charter. · If we happen to cancel due to weather you would not be responsible for any amount, although weather cancellations are at the Captains discretions for safety reasons.
